fusions.name: Digs Where It Smells
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Digging claws rake it for 9 damage and leave it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dust-Up
fusions.desc: Kicks grit and musk across a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Only the Tail Showing
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier of packed dirt that absorbs the next 22 damage, up to 4 blows, for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 6%.

fusions.name: Deepest Tunnel
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
